items.question: Do I need a separate bot for each location?
items.answer: No. One bot serves the whole chain: the guest picks a location — by geolocation or from a list — and sees the menu, prices and delivery zone of exactly that location. You promote one channel, and a new location goes live without a separate launch. The guest base, order history and points stay shared across the whole chain

items.question: Do guests have to sign up to see the menu?
items.answer: No. A guest opens the mini app in the messenger and immediately browses the menu, checks prices and fills the cart — no sign-up, no phone number, no location. The phone number and address are only needed at checkout

items.question: How will guests find out about the app?
items.answer: The same way they find out about you today — except they land in your own ordering channel. A link from an ad, social media, a blogger or search opens your menu right away, with nothing to install. A QR code in the dining room turns a visit into a subscription, and a QR code on the packaging brings back the guest who first ordered through an aggregator. And the cheapest channel of all is a line at the counter: “scan this and get a bonus on your next visit”

items.question: Do you bring guests in?
items.answer: Nyambot is the venue's own ordering app, under your name. We don't drive traffic — we land yours: ads, social media, bloggers, search, your sign and your packaging. The difference from an aggregator is not where the guest came from, but whose guest they are afterwards: someone who orders on a marketplace stays its guest — with its commission on every next order — while someone who comes to Nyambot follows your venue's bot and orders again directly

items.question: Will I have to replace my POS?
items.answer: No. Nyambot doesn't replace your POS and doesn't require one. With iiko or R-Keeper you connect the integration, and the menu, stop lists and orders sync automatically. With a different POS or none at all, Nyambot runs the menu, modifiers, loyalty and orders on its own CRM. Connect a POS later — nothing is lost

items.question: Do I have to talk to a sales manager or pay for onboarding?
items.answer: No. Signing up for the CRM takes an email and a password — no forms, no phone number. All plans and prices are published on this page. You set everything up in the CRM yourself — and if something is unclear, Anya, the built-in AI assistant, answers right inside the CRM: she knows how Nyambot works and helps with setup straight away, without waiting in the support queue. Human support steps in when you ask
